g.text: Shared-space L2 fitting: stronger paper-permitted P_T control on a fixed mesh
Every original field/rotation/budget stays. Main improvement changes only shared Bezier Z, preserving C0 and native bytes.

g.text: P_T uses each original interpolation-greedy triangle; it is not a newly projection-driven greedy adaptive mesh.
Higher-order P2 controls remain; identical-space fitting gains are separate from degree/encoding differences.
The complete unstable prototype is retained; weak-support controls stay at original Z under a fixed numerical rule.
All 126 outcomes retained. Finite source-function results, not a new P1 theorem or ground-truth/ArcGIS/CPU/GPU claims.
